items.text: Eagles OT Lane Johnson inactive today (personal reasons); rookie Markel Bell starts at RT. Eagles 18-29 without him. Backup RT Fred Johnson also out.
items.why: Listed Q for personal reasons then ruled inactive.
items.implication: Further depletes Eagles OL/protection vs Rams; Hurts and pass-catchers face elevated pressure risk.

items.text: Weekend summary: EXPECTED TO PLAY Puka Nacua, Zay Flowers, Ladd McConkey, Tyjae Spears; GTD/optimistic Mike Evans; NOT EXPECTED Jalen Coker, Terry McLaurin, Keenan Allen; Tyson Bagent starting.
items.why: Core Sunday morning dump aligning reports.
items.implication: Primary reference for lineup locks and GTD monitoring.

items.text: Commanders WR Terry McLaurin (hamstring) officially inactive today in London vs. the Colts.
items.why: Hamstring injury suffered late in week; ruled inactive.
items.implication: Remove from lineups; target volume shifts to other WAS WRs.

items.text: Rams do not intend to limit Puka Nacua’s workload today vs. the Eagles after his return from hip/groin issue.
items.why: Sources confirm full intended workload on return.
items.implication: Full WR1 usage expected; start with confidence.

items.text: Eagles could be without four key players today: RT Lane Johnson (personal), WR DeVonta Smith (hamstring), TE Dallas Goedert (knee), LB Zack Baun (concussion).
items.why: Multiple key absences compound protection and skill issues vs Rams.
items.implication: Downgrade Eagles pass catchers/Hurts ceiling; elevated risk.
items.opportunity: Secondary options may see more volume if game script allows.

items.text: Only small dock on Puka Nacua (groin) now after Schefter no-limit report; tinier dock on Zay Flowers (no hard pitch count); bigger docks on Ladd McConkey (foot/ribs) and Mike Evans (ribs).
items.implication: Nacua/Flowers closer to full; caution McConkey/Evans.

items.text: Mike Evans listed GTD/optimistic; will push to play through ribs per reports.
items.why: Practiced late week; team optimism though ribs painful.
items.implication: Monitor inactives; bigger dock if active; Kittle upside if limited/out.

items.text: Baker Mayfield dislocated thumb expected to sideline him 3-6 weeks depending on grip recovery.
items.implication: Extended absence; stream TB QB/WR adjustments.

items.text: Chargers WR Ladd McConkey (foot) likely to play today after week-long battle; rib not as serious factor.
items.why: Source: likely to play; foot not considered as serious as prior rib.
items.implication: Available but Levitan notes bigger projection dock; tough SEA matchup.
items.conflict: Bigger injury dock and tough DvP may limit upside despite active.

items.text: Ravens WR Zay Flowers (hamstring) expected to play today; not expected on hard pitch count.
items.why: Source confirms expected play with limited dock.
items.implication: Startable WR with near-full role vs TEN.

items.text: Moment Jordan Addison truthers waited for: home vs borderline NFL secondary with Justin Jefferson out.
Parlay: Garrett Wilson (no AD Mitchell, 3.5 dog), Michael Wilson (7+ targets every gm vs NYG), Addison without Jefferson vs MIA.
Excellent spot for Nico Collins (hamstring) return; DvP data has Cowboys inflating opposing WR scoring by 7.3% (most in NFL); Texans implied 7th-most points.
items.why: Best DvP inflation + solid team total.

items.text: Loves Jaylen Warren @ CLE: 90% snap rate last week, 20/22 RB touches; CLE allows 88+ rush yds every game; workhorse with Dowdle out.
items.why: Elite utilization + soft run D + clear lead role.

items.text: Loves Drake London @ NO: 35% career target share/104 ypg with Penix; 43.5% share last week (9-194); NO allows 5th-most WR TDs.
items.why: High target share with Penix + soft WR TD defense.

items.text: Loves Garrett Wilson @ CHI: AD Mitchell likely out again; 36% target share last without him; 78% catch rate, CHI allows 14+ ypr. Parlay lean too.
items.why: Clear alpha targets without Mitchell + favorable secondary.

items.text: Loves Josh Downs vs WSH (31% targets, 43% RZ looks; WSH worst vs WRs/slot TDs) and George Kittle vs DEN (climbing share, Evans GTD, DEN 8th-most TE yds).
items.why: Downs volume/RZ + soft WSH; Kittle rising + Evans uncertainty + soft TE D.
items.opportunity: Downs targets; Kittle if Evans limited.

items.text: Hates Omarion Hampton @ SEA (low util/target/route/3rd-down, SEA 2.9 YPC), Emeka Egbuka vs GB (rookie QB, low RZ, low total), Xavier Worthy @ LV (shrinking share vs Rice, low aDOT), Kyle Pitts @ NO (low share with Penix), Justin Herbert @ SEA (pressure, low YPA allowed, low total).
